question: Should WhatsApp injected media readers now fail closed unless callers provide explicit local roots, with these additive Plugin SDK exports as the permanent supported contract?
rationale: The branch intentionally closes a local-file capability that existing callers may rely on and expands third-party plugin API surface, so repository intent—not code correctness alone—must settle the compatibility boundary.

options.title: Keep explicit-root contract
options.body: Resolve the merge while retaining fail-closed injected readers, audit in-repo callers, and approve the smallest additive SDK surface.

options.title: Design a transition first
options.body: Pause landing and define a documented migration or deprecation path if rootless injected readers are considered a shipped supported contract.

options.title: Preserve implicit all-roots access
options.body: Restore the former compatibility behavior and accept the wider local-file capability, which conflicts with the canonical loader's security boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit-root contract
recommendation.body: Resolve the merge while retaining fail-closed injected readers, audit in-repo callers, and approve the smallest additive SDK surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the shared outbound access and filesystem-read capability contracts that this PR adopts.
